_readme: Canonical test vectors for Marco's inline token grammar ([LESSON_REF: ...], [MATCH_LOG: ...], [MATCH_PREP: ...]). IDENTICAL copies live in marco-api (internal/marco/testdata/token_fixtures.json) and marco-app (src/components/chat/token_fixtures.json) — update BOTH together; each repo's CI runs its implementation against its copy. The grammar itself is defined in marco-api internal/marco/prompt.md; if the prompt changes the token shapes, these fixtures and both parsers must change with it. Rules for shared cases: tokens must be complete (unterminated tokens are a streaming-only state, covered by the app's prefix property) and lesson-ref titles must not have leading/trailing spaces inside the quotes (the TS parser trims them, the Go parser does not). clean_text is the expected text after removing every token and trimming the ends — interior double spaces left by token removal are preserved, but a run of two or more blank LINES collapses to one, so a token written on its own line does not leave a hole in the rendered bubble. match_log / match_prep are server-side parse expectations (null = no valid token; match_prep compares mode and id, last valid token wins).
